text:
keisha: Pushed a tiny PR that adds a short NAT hairpin note, HSM/KMS port matrix, and an example conn-checker for Private installs. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5320

omar: quick skim : recommend 5698/tcp as required, 5699/tcp as optional admin. also call out appliances that require client cert CN match.

lucy: nit: use "allowlist" instead of older phrasing. also add a GPG-signed offline bundle example and a one-line sha256 verify example. customers in airgapped sites love the checksum snippet.

keisha: added both ports and labeled 5699 optional, added `gpg --verify` example and `openssl sha256` snippet. included example offline path `/opt/offline-bundles/redwood-2026-09.tar.gz` and a note about 256-char path limits on older filesystems.

omar: small troubleshooting note for NAT: some edge routers don't hairpin to the external IP; recommend testing with a local mapped hosts entry or use DNAT rules. added an `iptables` example in the PR.

lucy: SELinux note please: after extracting bundle on RHEL run `restorecon -R /opt/offline-bundles`. also add SysV/systemd hint: if the installer writes to /tmp, some units with PrivateTmp=true may block it. mention `PrivateTmp=false` as a fallback.

keisha: added SELinux and systemd notes. also included a 4-line conn-checker:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
nc -zv registry.internal 443
openssl s_client -connect registry.internal:443 -servername registry.internal < /dev/null | grep "Verify return code: 0"
curl -sSf http://localhost:8080/health
echo SMOKE OK
```

docs-bot: Lint OK. Broken links: 1 (external vendor HSM page). CI: queued.

omar: ran quick smoke on staging (ubuntu-22, installer v0.12.10):

keisha: thanks! I'll merge after CI green and file a follow-up for annotated conn-checker screenshots (issue #5321). cc @lucy for the GPG wording verification.
